task: Two-class classification of single, pre-cropped red-blood-cell images: parasitized vs uninfected.
training_data: NIH Malaria Cell Images dataset (National Library of Medicine), 27,558 single-cell crops from thin blood smears.
intended_use: Decision-support research prototype. Every result must be reviewed by a qualified laboratory professional. Not a diagnostic tool and not a validated parasite counter.
limitations: Trained on isolated cell crops; whole-smear photos are segmented heuristically first, so crops can differ from the training images.
Confidence scores are not calibrated clinical probabilities.
Not validated on images from Nigerian laboratories, other microscopes, stains or cameras.
metrics_provenance: Held-out test metrics are not yet available: the training run and its train/test split were not recorded in this repository.
_how_to_add_metrics: If you have the numbers from your training run, set metrics to {"accuracy": 0.0, "sensitivity": 0.0, "specificity": 0.0, "auc": 0.0, "test_images": 0} and describe where they came from in metrics_provenance.
